fusions.name: Behind the Skirting
fusions.desc: A quick bite from below that deals 24 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Underfoot Scramble
fusions.desc: You dart between the legs of every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 11 damage and tripping them into a 0.8 second stun. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Through the Wainscot
fusions.desc: A low scurry that carries you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: After Lamplight
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
